correctness.rationale: Independent iid batch epochs follow from strict subordinator increase and independent exponential operational epochs. Renewal boundary indicators yield the exact joint gap covariance. Rational partial fractions give an explicit damped complex-root transient; irrational-angle algebraic integer argument gives infinite critical sign changes. A uniform bounded-gap phase lemma implies the two-sided sharp logarithmic last-reversal asymptotic. The {1,2} case factors into two linear roots and forbids positive adjacent covariance. The package checker produced 1,310 finite diagnostics but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Time-changed clustered arrivals exhibit customer-index dependent startup correlations distinct from their stationary time-lag statistics. The theorem reveals an exact critical phase with infinitely recurring sign switches despite geometric amplitude decay, a sharp logarithmic length scale near criticality universal over non-exponential clocks, and a minimal burst-size obstruction.
